business.name: House of Classic
business.tagline: Your new party house, equipped with the best resources
business.description: House of Classic is a luxury party villa in Jaipur for bachelor's parties, birthdays, pool parties, family get-togethers and corporate events. Pool, dance floor, garden, cinema, gym and game zone.

address.street: C-9, Pratap Marg, Behind Science Park, Subhash Nagar

amenities.title: Swimming Pool
amenities.text: Spill, splash, dance and swim in our deep swimming pool, under a glass roof and a rainbow of light.

amenities.title: Party Garden
amenities.text: Spend your days and nights talking, walking or partying in this beautiful garden, which holds up to 70 people.

amenities.title: Dance Floor
amenities.text: Dance your worries away on a floor built for the purpose, with a built-in sound and lighting system.

amenities.title: Indoor Bar Area
amenities.text: Store, mix and pour all your drinks with ease, and make more memories at the bar.

amenities.title: Cinema Hall
amenities.text: A 17-seat cinema hall with comfortable recliners for the binge watchers in your group.

amenities.title: Game Zone
amenities.text: Table tennis, pool, carrom and chess for all the excitement, thrill and energy you want.

amenities.title: Terrace Gym
amenities.text: A refreshing terrace gym with a treadmill, cross trainer, multi-gym and cycle.

amenities.title: Luxurious Bedrooms
amenities.text: Three garden-facing bedrooms with fresh bedding, linens and toiletries.

home.heroText: Bring everyone together for birthdays, reunions and weekends away. A pool, party garden and cinema, all in one villa.

introParagraphs: House of Classic is a luxury party house made for your special occasions. With exemplary amenities, state-of-the-art sound systems, luxurious décor and a welcoming atmosphere, your stay here will be beyond perfect.
A 3-storey villa in the heart of Jaipur with 3 cozy bedrooms, an indoor pool, party garden, outdoor glass lounge, terrace gym, indoor and terrace bars, and a sports corner.
home.splashText: Pool time or a celebration until midnight. Explore 4-, 5- and 10-hour packages for up to 10 guests, from {fromPrice}.

amenities.heroText: Splash, relax and celebrate with everything you need under one roof.
amenities.alsoIncluded: Also included: outdoor and indoor kitchens, living and dining halls, an outdoor glass lounge, a suite room with steam and jacuzzi tub, and a rain dance area.

splash.heroText: A poolside afternoon or a celebration until midnight. Find the time and spaces that suit your group.
splash.packagesText: Every package includes the pool, living area, bar area and dining hall. Food is allowed; kitchen access depends on your package.
splash.bookingText: Send your preferred date on WhatsApp to confirm availability, the final payable amount and applicable terms before booking.
